name: doc_compare
description: Compare two documents from local paths or MinIO, summarize differences in Chinese, and optionally export a downloadable report.

path1.description: Path to the first document. Supports local path, relative path, or minio://bucket/path.

path2.description: Path to the second document. Supports local path, relative path, or minio://bucket/path.

download.description: Whether to export the comparison result as a downloadable file.
